Consider the reaction below. The limiting reagent is the one that is fully consumed first; any leftover reagent is said to be in excess.

Which statement is correct?

Answer:

Correct answer

The limiting reagent is oxygen, since it runs out first.

  • Oxygen: 0 mol remaining
  • Fuel: 2 mol remaining
